measures.name: #  testcountLeasedNotStarted2
measures.expression:
var filterName =   SELECTEDVALUE('Filter Toggles'[Filter Name], "Count")
var test = SELECTEDVALUE('Deal Stage'[Deal Stage Order], 20)
var budgetSK = SELECTEDVALUE('Version'[Version SK])
var unitSK = SELECTEDVALUE('Lease'[Unit SK], -1)
RETURN
    SWITCH(filterName
            , "Count",  CALCULATE(DISTINCTCOUNT('Occupancies'[Unit SK]), 'Occupancies'[Occupied] = 0,
                   FILTER(ALL('Deal Stage'), 'Deal Stage'[Deal Stage Order] >= test
            ))
          + 
        CALCULATE(DISTINCTCOUNT('Occupancies'[Unit SK]), 'Occupancies'[Occupied] = 1, Occupancies[Holdover] = 0 && Occupancies[HOA Signed] = 0 && Occupancies[Deal Completed] = 0, 
            FILTER(
                ALL('Deal Stage'),
                'Deal Stage'[Deal Stage Order] >= test))
            , "Area", CALCULATE(SUM('Occupancies'[Rentable Area]), 'Occupancies'[Occupied] = 0,                   FILTER(ALL('Deal Stage'),
            'Deal Stage'[Deal Stage Order] >= test))  + 
        CALCULATE(SUM('Occupancies'[Rentable Area]), 'Occupancies'[Occupied] = 1, Occupancies[Holdover] = 0 && Occupancies[HOA Signed] = 0 && Occupancies[Deal Completed] = 0,  FILTER(
                ALL('Deal Stage'),
                'Deal Stage'[Deal Stage Order] >= test))


            , "Income (Net)", CALCULATE(SUM('Leasing Asset Plan'[Market Net Rent Amount]), 'Leasing Asset Plan'[Unit SK] = unitSK, 'Version'[Version SK] = budgetSK, 'Occupancies'[Occupied] = 0,
            FILTER(
        ALL('Deal Stage'),
       'Deal Stage'[Deal Stage Order] >= test
    ),REMOVEFILTERS('Calendar'))
  + 
        CALCULATE(SUM('Leasing Asset Plan'[Market Net Rent Amount]), 'Leasing Asset Plan'[Unit SK] = unitSK, 'Version'[Version SK] = budgetSK, 'Occupancies'[Occupied] = 1, Occupancies[Holdover] = 0 && Occupancies[HOA Signed] = 0 && Occupancies[Deal Completed] = 0,  
    FILTER(
        ALL('Deal Stage'),
        'Deal Stage'[Deal Stage Order] >= test
    ),REMOVEFILTERS('Calendar'))

            , "Income (Gross)", CALCULATE(SUM('Leasing Asset Plan'[Market Net Rent Amount]), 'Leasing Asset Plan'[Unit SK] = unitSK, 'Version'[Version SK] = budgetSK, 'Occupancies'[Occupied] = 0,  FILTER(ALL('Deal Stage'),
            'Deal Stage'[Deal Stage Order] >= test)) + 
        CALCULATE(SUM('Occupancies'[Rentable Area]), 'Occupancies'[Occupied] = 1, Occupancies[Holdover] = 0 && Occupancies[HOA Signed] = 0 && Occupancies[Deal Completed] = 0,  FILTER(
                ALL('Deal Stage'),
                'Deal Stage'[Deal Stage Order] >= test))
        , 0
    )

measures.name: # Test Operational Occ % latest
measures.expression:
var filterName =   SELECTEDVALUE('Filter Toggles'[Filter Name], "Count")
var test = SELECTEDVALUE('Deal Stage'[Deal Stage Order], 20)
var selMonth = SELECTEDVALUE('Calendar'[First of Month], CALCULATE(MIN('Calendar'[First of Month]), REMOVEFILTERS('Calendar'), 'Calendar'[Date] = TODAY()))
VAR vacantUnits =
    CALCULATETABLE(
        VALUES('Occupancies'[Unit Sk]),
        REMOVEFILTERS('Calendar'),
        'Calendar'[Date] = selMonth,
        'Occupancies'[Occupied] = 0,
        FILTER(
            ALL('Deal Stage'),
            'Deal Stage'[Deal Stage Order] >= test
        )
    )

var grossopvac =
    CALCULATE(
        [# Current Vacant Gross Rent],
        TREATAS(vacantUnits, 'Leasing Asset Plan'[Unit SK]),
        REMOVEFILTERS('Calendar'),
        'Calendar'[Date] = selMonth
    )
 
var netopvac =
    CALCULATE(
        [# Current Vacant Net Rent],
        TREATAS(vacantUnits, 'Leasing Asset Plan'[Unit SK]),
        REMOVEFILTERS('Calendar'),
        'Calendar'[Date] = selMonth
    )
 
RETURN
    SWITCH(filterName
            , "Count", 
            //[# Occupied Units] + [#  testcountLeasedNotStarted 1]
             DIVIDE(CALCULATE([# Occupied Units],REMOVEFILTERS('Deal Stage'[Deal Display Name])) + [#  testcountLeasedNotStarted2], 
             CALCULATE([# Occupied Units] + [# Vacant Units],REMOVEFILTERS('Deal Stage'[Deal Display Name])))
            , "Area", DIVIDE(CALCULATE([# Occupied Area], REMOVEFILTERS('Deal Stage'))  + [#  testcountLeasedNotStarted2], CALCULATE([# Lettable Area], REMOVEFILTERS('Deal Stage')))
            , "Income (Net)", DIVIDE(CALCULATE([# Current Occupied Net Rent], REMOVEFILTERS('Deal Stage')) + netopvac, CALCULATE([# Current Occupied + Vacant Net Rent], REMOVEFILTERS('Deal Stage')))
            , "Income (Gross)", DIVIDE(CALCULATE([# Current Occupied Gross Rent], REMOVEFILTERS('Deal Stage')) + grossopvac, CALCULATE([# Current Occupied + Vacant Gross Rent], REMOVEFILTERS('Deal Stage')))
        , 0
    )

var test = SELECTEDVALUE('Deal Stage'[Deal Stage Order], 20)
var selMonth = SELECTEDVALUE('Calendar'[First of Month], CALCULATE(MIN('Calendar'[First of Month]), REMOVEFILTERS('Calendar'), 'Calendar'[Date] = TODAY()))

   CALCULATETABLE(
        VALUES('Occupancies'[Unit Sk]),

        'Calendar'[Date] = selMonth,
        'Occupancies'[Occupied] = 0,
        FILTER(
            ALL('Deal Stage'),
            'Deal Stage'[Deal Stage Order] >= test
        )
    )
var grossopvac = 
    CALCULATE(
        [# Current Vacant Gross Rent],
        TREATAS(vacantUnits, 'Leasing Asset Plan'[Unit SK]),
        REMOVEFILTERS('Calendar'),
        'Calendar'[Date] = selMonth
    )
var netopvac =

measures.name: test cmlVacant
measures.expression:
var filterName =   SELECTEDVALUE('Filter Toggles'[Filter Name], "Count")
var selMonth = SELECTEDVALUE('Calendar'[First of Month], CALCULATE(MIN('Calendar'[First of Month]), REMOVEFILTERS('Calendar'), 'Calendar'[Date] = TODAY()))
var test = SELECTEDVALUE('Deal Stage'[Deal Stage Order], 20)
VAR endDate =
    SELECTEDVALUE('Calendar'[End Of Month], TODAY())
VAR startDate =
    SELECTEDVALUE('Calendar'[First of Month],CALCULATE(MIN('Calendar'[First of Month]),'Calendar'[Date] = TODAY()))
VAR vacantUnits =
    CALCULATETABLE(
        VALUES('Occupancies'[Unit Sk]),
        REMOVEFILTERS('Calendar'),
        'Calendar'[Date] = selMonth,
        'Occupancies'[Occupied] = 0,
        FILTER(
            ALL('Deal Stage'),
            'Deal Stage'[Deal Stage Order] >= test
        
    ))
VAR cmlAmendmentUnitSKs =
    CALCULATETABLE(
        VALUES('Deal Workflows'[Amendment Unit Sk]),
        'Deal Workflow Step'[Workflow Step Name] = "Agreement Approved",
        'Deal Workflow Status'[Status] = "Complete",
        'Deal Workflows'[Step Complete Date] <= endDate,
        'Lease'[Income Stream] = "Vacant",
        'Amendment'[Amendment To] > startDate,
        'Amendment'[Amendment From] <= endDate
    )
VAR cmlUnitSKs =
    CALCULATETABLE(
        VALUES('Amendment Unit'[Unit Sk]),
        TREATAS(
            cmlAmendmentUnitSKs,
            'Amendment Unit'[Amendment Unit Sk]
        )
    )
VAR vacantUnitsExcludingCML =
    EXCEPT(vacantUnits,cmlUnitSKs)
var grossopvac = 
    CALCULATE(
        [# Current Vacant Gross Rent],
        TREATAS(vacantUnitsExcludingCML, 'Leasing Asset Plan'[Unit SK]),
        REMOVEFILTERS('Calendar'),
        'Calendar'[Date] = selMonth
    )

var netopvac = 
    CALCULATE(
        [# Current Vacant Net Rent],
        TREATAS(vacantUnitsExcludingCML, 'Leasing Asset Plan'[Unit SK]),
        REMOVEFILTERS('Calendar'),
        'Calendar'[Date] = selMonth
    )

RETURN
    SWITCH(filterName
            , "Count",  DIVIDE(CALCULATE([# test new vacant], REMOVEFILTERS('Deal Stage')) - [#  testcountLeasedNotStarted2] - CALCULATE([# CML Vacant Count], REMOVEFILTERS('Deal Stage')), CALCULATE(([# Occupied Units] + [# Vacant Units]), REMOVEFILTERS('Deal Stage')))
            , "Area", DIVIDE(CALCULATE([# test new vacant], REMOVEFILTERS('Deal Stage'))  - [#  testcountLeasedNotStarted2] - CALCULATE([test cmlvacant area], REMOVEFILTERS('Deal Stage')), CALCULATE([# Lettable Area], REMOVEFILTERS('Deal Stage')))
            , "Income (Net)", DIVIDE(CALCULATE([# Current Vacant Net Rent], REMOVEFILTERS('Deal Stage')) - netopvac, CALCULATE(([# Current Occupied + Vacant Net Rent]), REMOVEFILTERS('Deal Stage')))
            , "Income (Gross)", DIVIDE(CALCULATE([# Current Vacant Gross Rent], REMOVEFILTERS('Deal Stage')) - grossopvac, CALCULATE(([# Current Occupied + Vacant Gross Rent]), REMOVEFILTERS('Deal Stage')))
        , 0
    )
